title: Grandson in trouble (scam)
note: Scripted role-play written by the team. Not a real call.

lines.speaker: them
lines.text: Grandma? It's me, Sam. I'm in trouble, I've been in an accident.

lines.speaker: them
lines.text: Hello ma'am, this is officer Daniels. Your grandson hit a car and he is being held.

lines.speaker: them
lines.text: Please don't tell mom and dad, I'm so embarrassed.

lines.speaker: me
lines.text: Sam, what happened? Are you hurt?

lines.speaker: them
lines.text: I need money for bail today, 2,000 dollars. You can buy gift cards at the pharmacy.

lines.speaker: me
lines.text: Let me call you back on your usual number.

lines.speaker: them
lines.text: There's no time for that, my phone is broken. Why don't you trust me?
